name: Kettle & Co.
tagline: D2C artisan tea rooted in everyday ritual
description: Fictional artisanal tea brand celebrating authentic Indian tea traditions with uncompromised quality and clean labeling.
voice_tone: Warm, plain, grounded, never medical or sensational

rules.title: Banned promotional terms
rules.text: Never use sensationalist or misleading terms: 'cheap', 'guaranteed', or 'miracle'. Use 'accessible value' or specific descriptors instead.

rules.title: Product name casing & typography
rules.text: Always write 'Masala Chai' in Title Case and 'Kettle & Co.' with an ampersand (&), never 'Kettle and Co' or 'Kettle & company'.

rules.title: Indian English (en-IN) spelling conventions
rules.text: Adhere strictly to Indian English spellings: 'flavour' (not flavor), 'colour' (not color), 'organise' (not organize).

rules.title: Unsubstantiated superlatives restriction
rules.text: Do not make unsupported superlative claims such as 'best', 'number one', or '#1' unless an active, approved fact in the facts register substantiates the ranking with verifiable third-party certification.

rules.title: Medical & health claims prohibition
rules.text: Health, curative, or medical efficacy claims ('cure', 'clinically proven', 'treats', 'detox') are strictly prohibited without an approved regulatory clinical trial dossier.

rules.title: Mandatory promotional email disclaimer
rules.text: All promotional communications offering discounts, bundles, or gifts must include: 'Offer valid while stocks last. T&Cs apply.'

rules.title: Calm readability & shouting prohibition
rules.text: Maintain friendly, humble, and conversational copy. Avoid all-caps shouting (3 or more consecutive capitalized words) and keep text readability at or below Grade 8.

rules.title: Mandatory AI content disclosure
rules.text: Any external marketing asset drafted with generative AI tools must include: 'Created with AI assistance and reviewed by our team.'

facts.subject: Organic Ingredients
facts.value: Made with certified organic tea leaves
facts.permitted_wording: Made with 100% certified organic estate tea leaves

facts.subject: Masala Chai 250g Price
facts.permitted_wording: Masala Chai 250 g is priced at ₹349 (inclusive of all taxes)

facts.subject: Free Shipping Threshold
facts.permitted_wording: Free domestic shipping on orders over ₹499

name: LedgerLeaf
tagline: Intelligent automated accounting & wealth management for modern professionals
description: Fictional fintech platform offering compliant expense tracking, verified portfolio insights, and automated bank reconciliation.

rules.title: Unsubstantiated financial promises prohibition
rules.text: Never promise 'guaranteed returns', 'risk-free' investment, or 'zero fees' without an explicit, active fact registration and regulatory disclosure.

rules.title: Mandatory risk disclaimer on performance figures
rules.text: Any mention of investment returns, percentage gains, or historic yields must be accompanied by the statutory risk notice.

rules.title: Mandatory investment market risk disclaimer
rules.text: Must include exact disclaimer: 'Investments are subject to market risks. Read all scheme-related documents carefully.'

rules.title: Product nomenclature & deprecated brand names
rules.text: Always write 'LedgerLeaf Plus' (with space and word Plus). Never write 'Ledger Leaf+' or 'LedgerLeaf+'. The previous name 'LeafSave' is deprecated and must not be used.

facts.subject: LedgerLeaf Plus Subscription Price
facts.permitted_wording: LedgerLeaf Plus subscription is ₹199 per month billed monthly or annually

facts.subject: Free Tier Account Limit
facts.permitted_wording: Free tier enables up to 5 linked bank and credit accounts

facts.subject: Customer Support Operating Hours
facts.value: 9 AM to 6 PM IST, Monday to Saturday
facts.permitted_wording: Live support desk available 9 AM to 6 PM IST, Monday through Saturday
